summary: Q/C Technologies filed a Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, reporting the appointment of Yossef Ehrlichman, 49, as Chief Technology Officer effective September 14, 2026, along with a First Amendment to his August 1, 2026 employment agreement raising base salary to $275,000 from $260,000 and changing his title. This is an ordinary executive appointment and compensation arrangement rather than a forced departure or abrupt board change, with no board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics involved. There is no arbitrage angle; watch for further leadership and operational developments in its optical computing program.
